# Assumption of Moses Chapter 3 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Monarchy, Division, and Exile

---

**1** And when the years of that time are completed, then they will enter the land and they will reign there.

**2** The great ones among them will become oppressors; they will sell righteous men and will seize great estates and cast down justice.

**3** They will defile the sanctuary with their impurity and will commit sins in the place of the holy.

**4** They will be corrupted, and they will defile the altar with the very gifts they bring to the Lord.

**5** For they are not true priests but slaves born of slaves.

**6** And so among the twelve tribes of Israel there will arise a king who is young in years and who will reign for only a short time.

**7** Two of the tribes will be separated from the ten tribes, and three of the kings will be transferred to their own land.

**8** They will build for themselves a tower, and the four of them will establish it.

**9** But after this their period of power will end, for they will be led away captive into the east.

**10** Then the two tribes will weep there and say: how has this come upon us, and all this misery?

**11** But then the Most High will remember the covenant which he made with the fathers.

**12** And he will make himself manifest and go out to them, punish their enemies, and raise them up.

**13** Let no tribe or nation therefore boast over them.

**14** For they are the holy ones of the Lord, set apart and consecrated to him.
